products.title: Rock & Cliff Trim Sheet Pack
products.excerpt: Twelve hand-authored rock & cliff trims — tileable, PBR, game-ready.
products.body:
A pack of **twelve** rock and cliff trim sheets pulled straight from production habits — the same setups I reach for when a canyon needs to read from 50 metres *and* hold up at hero distance.

## What's inside

- 12 trims at 4K, tileable on one axis
- Full PBR set: albedo, normal, roughness, AO, height
- A ready-to-drop `.sbsar` so you can retune wear and colour
- A quick-start note on trim UVs

Instant download after checkout. Yours to use in personal and commercial work.

products.title: Environment Brush Kit — Blender
products.excerpt: Sculpt & texture-paint brushes for fast rock, bark, soil and debris.
products.body:
The brush set I use to rough in natural surfaces fast: rock chips, bark, packed soil, gravel and scattered debris. Sculpt and texture-paint variants included.

Drop the `.blend` in your startup file or append as needed. Alpha PNGs are included for other DCCs.

products.title: Sci-Fi Modular Kit — Unreal 5
products.excerpt: A modular corridor & bay kit — snap-ready, Nanite-friendly, fully dressed.
products.body:
A modular sci-fi kit built to snap on a grid: corridors, junctions, doorways, a bay and a pile of greeble. Nanite-friendly, lightmapped fallbacks included.

Ships as an Unreal 5 project plus raw FBX if you want to bring it elsewhere.

products.title: Lighting Breakdowns · Vol. 1
products.excerpt: Five scenes, taken apart light by light — why each choice was made.
products.body: A 58-page PDF that takes five finished scenes apart **one light at a time**, with the reasoning behind each call — where to fake it, where to pay for it, and how to move the eye without moving the geometry.

products.title: “Lookout” — Giclée Print
products.excerpt: Museum-grade giclée on archival matte stock. Ships worldwide.
products.body:
A giclée print of *Lookout*, on 240gsm archival matte with pigment inks that hold their colour for decades.

Printed to order and shipped flat in a rigid mailer. Choose your size at checkout.

products.title: Studio Sticker Pack

products.body: Eight die-cut vinyl stickers from the studio — weatherproof, dishwasher-brave, and sized for a laptop lid or a hard case. Ships in a flat mailer.

products.title: Environments — Artbook Vol. 1
products.excerpt: 132 pages of environment work, process and breakdowns. Signed.
products.body:
A 132-page collection of environment work with process pages and breakdowns throughout — the finished shots *and* the scaffolding behind them.

Every copy is signed. Softcover and hardcover editions; ships worldwide.
